title: New Plymouth Gym Deals

sections.heading: Money-Saving Tips for Joining a Gym in New Plymouth
sections.body: Joining a gym can be a significant investment, but there are ways to save money. Firstly, consider the Exercise NZ subsidy scheme, which can provide 40-70% off your membership. Secondly, look for gyms that offer no-contract options or free trials, such as Contours or Snap Fitness. Thirdly, think about your fitness goals and choose a gym that meets your needs, rather than paying for unnecessary extras. Finally, be sure to read the fine print and understand the terms of your membership before signing up.
